chunks: "Regarding animals: do not strike the faces, and do not curse them, for Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has cursed the one who curses them."
And in another report: "Do not make faces ugly."
ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام teach about striking or cursing animals?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches mercy and proper conduct toward animals, specifically forbidding striking their faces and cursing them. It also prohibits demeaning or disfiguring faces, emphasizing dignity and restraint in treatment of living creatures.
